description: This file defines the SugarSpriteBuilder class responsible for creating sprite images and associated CSS in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for processing image files, generating sprite sheets, and managing sprite placement configurations. The class is also responsible for handling support for different image types and optimizing sprite creation workflows, along with a helper class SpritePlacement for arranging the sprites within the sprite sheet.

classes.name: SugarSpriteBuilder
classes.description: A class for building image sprites and corresponding CSS/metadata files for optimizing web asset loading in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: SpritePlacement
classes.description: A helper class for determining the placement and arrangement of images within a sprite sheet, supporting various layout algorithms.

methods.name: addDirectory
methods.description: Adds a directory of images to the sprite source list for a given sprite namespace.

methods.name: getFileList
methods.description: Processes files within a directory, filtering images according to supported types and constraints.

methods.name: loadSpritesConfig
methods.description: Loads optional sprite configuration from a sprites_config.php file in the specified directory.

methods.name: getFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves image dimensions and type information for a given file if supported.

methods.name: createSprites
methods.description: Main method to generate sprite images, CSS files, and metadata.

methods.name: initSpriteImg
methods.description: Initializes the true color image resource for the sprite sheet with transparency.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Creates an image resource from a file based on its type.

methods.name: logMessage
methods.description: Logs messages to output or log file depending on configuration.
